_what: Hand-placed EYE-LEVEL hero camera for the v4 master-bedroom suite (the L-shaped suite). Merge the 'eye_camera' block below into the room spec, then render with build_room --eye. Kept as a SIDECAR (not injected into 03_layout/v4/scene-graph.master_bedroom.json) because that spec is owner-signed geometry under active parallel-session review — the camera is a Stage-04 concern, not a Stage-03 geometry edit.
_why_manual: camera_config.solve_eye_camera's AUTO heuristic takes the FARTHEST clear grid spot from the subject. For this L-suite that backs the lens into the SW corner (stand 1.20,3.55): ~55% of the frame is a dead blank wall (the full-height wardrobe/console face, counted as 'furniture' by frame_subject_share=0.927 yet reading as a wall), the bed is clipped into the right third, and the foot bench floats in the corner. A designer places the spot by hand instead. This is the exact case the new spec['eye_camera'] override (camera_config.py, 2026-07-11) exists for.

eye_camera._note: stand W of the bed foot, look E across the bed toward the slat feature wall (BF14, x5150); 26 mm reads the whole alcove + both side walls; shift_y -0.18 frames DOWN to kill the empty upper wall an eye-level level camera sees over a 0.6 m bed. Validated by camera_config _spot_is_clear (inside outline, >=0.3 m clear of built-ins, level LOS to 0.95x the aim past the wardrobe/console/slat-wall ray-blocks): standoff 3.83 m, subject share 0.93, manual=True.

s26_tighter._note: bed more dominant, more foreground floor, ~35% upper wall — pick if the beauty pass wants a lower headboard band.

diagonal_35mm._note: 3/4 diagonal across the bed; slat wall on the right — a second angle if a set of 2 is wanted.

_height_note: Eye Z = camera_config.DEFAULT_EYE_CAM_HEIGHT_M = 1.15 m (designer M3.2 GS-15 calibration: 1.0-1.2 m so the ceiling doesn't read low). For a true standing-eye A/B set env EYE_CAM_HEIGHT_M=1.5 before rendering.
_render_command: cd pipeline/scripts && python -c "import json,copy; ec=json.load(open('../../projects/PRJ-2026-002_c001-house/04_visualization/eye-camera.master_bedroom.json',encoding='utf-8'))['eye_camera']; s=json.load(open('../../projects/PRJ-2026-002_c001-house/03_layout/v4/scene-graph.master_bedroom.json',encoding='utf-8')); s['eye_camera']={k:v for k,v in ec.items() if not k.startswith('_')}; json.dump(s,open('_hero_spec.json','w',encoding='utf-8'),ensure_ascii=False)" && "/c/Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender 5.1/blender.exe" -b --python build_room.py -- _hero_spec.json --render --eye   # -> pipeline/output/room_bedroom_suite_eye.png (clay control, 2000x1400, Cycles 256spp)
